title: should render a bounded window of rows with spacer rows for a large dataset
verifies: a large dataset renders only a bounded window of DOM rows (<=100) plus spacer rows, not the full set

title: should slide the render window toward the tail when scrolling to the bottom
verifies: scrolling to the bottom advances the rendered data-index window toward the dataset tail

title: should disable virtual scroll when wrap cells is enabled (no spacers, unbounded rows)
verifies: enabling wrap cells bypasses virtual scroll: zero spacer rows and unbounded rendered rows

title: should disable virtual scroll when pagination is enabled (paged rows, no spacers)
verifies: enabling pagination bypasses virtual scroll: exactly rowsPerPage rows, no spacers, paged footer visible

title: should render all rows with no spacers for a small dataset that fits the viewport
verifies: a small dataset renders its full window with zero spacer rows
